visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A female presenter with light brown hair, wearing a pink button-down shirt and a white skirt, sits in a brightly lit indoor studio with a white wall and refrigerator background. She introduces a beige trolley bag, gesturing towards it with a smile. (2) Detailed shots of the trolley follow, showing both beige and grey versions. The woman demonstrates the two-stage adjustable metal handle and points to the detachable bag feature, which is secured to the frame by wide velcro straps. (3) The camera focuses on the bottom of the trolley to reveal five 360-degree rotating wheels. A cutaway shows the trolley placed on the floorboard of a gray scooter outdoors on a paved sidewalk. (4) Close-up views highlight the water-resistant fabric of the bag and a specialized rain cover being pulled from a front zippered pocket. The woman demonstrates various side pockets suitable for water bottles or small personal items. (5) The presenter opens the top lid, which has a double zipper, and places a rectangular ice pack into a mesh pocket. She then detaches and pulls out the thick, silver insulated inner lining to show it is easy to clean. (6) The video concludes with the woman standing next to the trolley, gesturing enthusiastically while holding a box of laundry pods. Promotional graphics appear on screen as she delivers a final message to the viewers.

The background features a bright, medium-tempo acoustic guitar BGM with light percussion. The vocal mix is professional and clear, occupying the front of the spectral field. (2) As the speaker transitions into product features, several digital pop and whoosh SFX are used to emphasize on-screen graphics. Distinct mechanical clicks are audible when the trolley handle is adjusted, indicating a high-fidelity capture of incidental sounds. (3) The rhythmic guitar-based BGM continues continuously as the speaker's delivery maintains a fast, persuasive pace. Occasional fabric rustling and muffled thud sounds occur during the demonstration of the detachable bag components. (4) The final phase features a sharp ding SFX to highlight promotional text. The speaker's arousal level remains high, conveying excitement for the sales event. The track concludes with the voice trailing off just before the music is abruptly cut.
